metadata.description: Claude plugins for Soxoa LLC's seven products (MentionedOn, Intakra, Soxoa, Postedly, Portravo, Ocolta and RegSentry), each pairing the product's live remote MCP server with skills, plus Soxoa Ops: skills-only operating routines.

plugins.name: mentionedon
plugins.description: See how AI assistants mention your business: saved checks, share of voice, results, articles, referrals and website fixes, plus free evidence scoring.

plugins.name: intakra
plugins.description: Today's leads, account changes and who to reach from your Intakra list, plus free scoring of buying-signal evidence you supply.

plugins.name: soxoa
plugins.description: Estimate illustrative automation ROI, rank workflows for automate, assist or discovery, and draft a reviewable pilot plan.

plugins.name: postedly
plugins.description: Send real faxes, letters, certified mail, postcards, handwritten cards and paper checks, approved and paid by you on Postedly's review page.

plugins.name: portravo
plugins.description: Turn construction plan PDFs into reviewed takeoffs and Excel estimates in your Portravo account, with approval of the exact credits first.

plugins.name: ocolta
plugins.description: Read categorical summaries from your recoverable Ocolta Deep Reviews and plan fair document-verification follow-up.

plugins.name: regsentry
plugins.description: Check which trackers a site you own loads before and after consent, compare runs, export reports and get playbooks. Technical evidence, not legal advice.

plugins.name: soxoa-ops
plugins.description: Fifteen operating skills: feedback inbox, signup alerts, daily brief, owner actions, claim audit, ad path check, prospect research, marketing kit, voice guide, evidence articles, AI output review and automation scoping.
